faqs.a: International students are obliged to have Overseas Student Health Cover, also known as OSHC. We can help you with the process and arrange a suitable OSHC policy. There are only five government-approved providers of Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) in Australia: AHMI, Nib, Bupa, Medibank, and Allianz Care.
faqs.q: Do I need Overseas Student Health Cover?

faqs.a: Students with student visas can often work while studying, but always be sure to check your current work rights before beginning employment.
faqs.q: Can I work while studying in Australia?

faqs.a: It depends on the course and provider, but international students might qualify for scholarships.
Some Student visa applicants may need a health examination. We can guide you through the booking process when required.
faqs.q: Do I need a visa medical examination?

Requirements vary by visa type and destination, but as a general guide you should be able to show enough funds to cover tuition plus at least a year of living costs. Your counselor will confirm the exact figure for your specific visa and destination.
